validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: real and well documented. Transco (Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company, LLC, a Williams subsidiary) filed a FERC application on Nov. 18, 2014 (Docket CP15-16-000/PF14-6-000) for the Hillabee Expansion Project -- 43.5 mi of looping + 88,500 hp compression in Alabama, leased entirely to Sabal Trail Transmission (Federal Register notice, govinfo.gov, independent govt-published source, names 'Hillabee Expansion Project' and 'Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company'). FERC issued the certificate Feb. 2, 2016 (154 FERC P61,080). The project was built in phases: Phase I (818 Mdth/d) went in service July 2017 -- this is GEM's P0/P2733 row (roster shows P2733 len=35.41 dia=? cap=818.00, capacity matches exactly). Phase II -- this row -- was placed in service May 1, 2020, per Williams' own press release (verified via Wayback since the live investor.williams.com page 403s to scripted clients: Wayback capture 2020-08-13, byte-identical business-wire text) and confirmed independently by Williams' SEC Form 10-Q for Q2 2019 ('the in-service date of Phase II is planned for the second quarter of 2020'). CLASSIFICATION: correctly recorded as an operating gas transmission pipeline segment (Transco mainline capacity expansion, not a gathering/lateral line) -- both sources describe it as an expansion of Transco's existing interstate transmission system. DUPLICATE CHECK: not a duplicate. Roster has three Transcontinental Gas Pipeline / Alabama rows: P2544 (this row, Hillabee Phase 2, cap 206), P2733 (Hillabee Phase 1, cap 818 -- matches independently), and P2607 (dia 36in cap 400, ends Louisiana -- a different, unrelated Transco project, not part of Hillabee). No overlap. CROSS-ROW LEAD (not staged as a fills object, no roster PID to route it to): trade press (naturalgasintel.com, 2014-11-19) and Industrial Info Resources (industrialinfo.com, 'Williams Progresses with Transco Expansion Projects') both describe a planned Hillabee 'Phase III' (~107,000 Dth/d of the original 1,131,730 Dth/d authorization not yet built by Phase I+II, ~$380M total investment value across all three phases combined) expected to complete circa 2021 -- this phase does not appear to have its own PID anywhere in the 37-row roster. Flagging for the orchestrator/Discovery, not claiming it here.

One search result surfaced a $167.4 million FERC figure that I verified traces to a DIFFERENT Transco project entirely (Gulf Connector Expansion Project, Docket CP16-494, Southeast Texas) -- confirmed by pulling and reading the actual FERC order PDF (161 FERC P61,214); did not use it, would have been a false attribution.
